metadata.title: Oster, Murray & Harris (1983) / Oster, Murray & Maini (1985) Mechanochemical Chondrogenesis, Limb Condensation Bifurcation & Salamander Limb Skeleton Dataset

sources.citation: Oster GF, Murray JD, Harris AK (1983). Mechanical aspects of mesenchymal morphogenesis. Journal of Embryology and Experimental Morphology 78(1):83-125.

Oster GF, Murray JD, Maini PK (1985). A model for chondrogenic condensations in the developing limb: the role of extracellular matrix and cell tractions. Journal of Embryology and Experimental Morphology 89(1):93-112.
Murray JD, Oster GF (1984). Generation of biological pattern and form. IMA Journal of Mathematics Applied in Medicine and Biology 1(1):51-75.
Shubin NH, Alberch P (1986). A morphogenetic approach to the origin and basic organization of the tetrapod limb. Evolutionary Biology 20:319-387.
Saunders JW Jr (1948). The proximo-distal sequence of origin of the parts of the chick wing and the role of the ectoderm. Journal of Experimental Zoology 108(3):363-403.
Raspopovic J, Marcon L, Russo L, Sharpe J (2014). Digit patterning is controlled by a Bmp-Sox9-Wnt Turing network modulated by morphogen gradients. Science 345(6196):566-570.

salamander_limb_cartilage_specimen.species: Oedipina ecuatoriana / Urodela salamander forelimb (humerus -> ulna+radius -> 4 digits I-IV) and hindlimb (femur -> tibia+fibula -> 5 digits I-V) skeletal micro-CT reconstruction

oster_murray_1983_1985_governing_equatio.section: Oster, Murray & Harris (1983) J. Embryol. Exp. Morph. 78:83-125 Eqs. (1)-(12); Oster, Murray & Maini (1985) J. Embryol. Exp. Morph. 89:93-112 Eqs. (1)-(9)
oster_murray_1983_1985_governing_equatio.cell_conservation_pde: dn/dt = D_1 * laplacian(n) - D_2 * biharmonic(n) - div(n * du/dt) + r * n * (N_0 - n)
oster_murray_1983_1985_governing_equatio.ecm_mechanical_balance_pde: div(mu_1 * d_eps/dt + mu_2 * div(du/dt) * I + E' * (eps + nu' * theta * I) + (tau * n^2 / (1 + lambda * n^2)) * I) = s * rho * u
oster_murray_1983_1985_governing_equatio.linearized_dispersion_relation: mu * k^4 * sigma(k) + [mu * D_2 * k^6 + (mu * D_1 + E_eff - tau_eff * n_0) * k^4 + (s + mu * r * N_0) * k^2] + [D_2 * s * k^4 + (D_1 * s + r * N_0 * (E_eff - tau_eff * n_0)) * k^2 + r * N_0 * s] = 0
oster_murray_1983_1985_governing_equatio.critical_traction_bifurcation: tau_eff > tau_c = E_eff + D_1 * s / (r * N_0) + 2 * sqrt(D_2 * s * E_eff)

state_variables.n: Mesenchymal chondroblast cell density (dimensionless normalized to equilibrium N_0 = 1)
state_variables.tau: Cell traction force coefficient per unit cell density with contact-inhibition saturation lambda

script_default_parameters.note: Parameters actually used by 1983-oster-mechanochemical-chondrogenesis.py (critical_traction_threshold, dispersion_growth_rate, 1D/2D solvers). They differ from `canonical_parameters` above (which were transcribed at scout time and never adopted by the script); the discrepancy is disclosed in audit v3 and carried as a Pass 4 reconciliation item.

tetrapod_limb_branching_hierarchy_table.source: Oster, Murray & Maini (1985) J. Embryol. Exp. Morph. 89:93-112 Figs. 4-9; Shubin & Alberch (1986) Evol. Biol. 20:319-387
tetrapod_limb_branching_hierarchy_table.description: As the developing limb bud elongates and flattens distally (increasing aspect ratio W/L_c or effective traction tau_eff), the unstable mechanochemical wavenumber mode m = round(W / lambda_c) transitions through 1 -> 2 -> 4 (urodele forelimb) and 1 -> 2 -> 5 (urodele hindlimb).

zones.label: Pre-condensation undifferentiated limb bud mesenchyme (tau < tau_c)
Proximal Stylopod (Humerus / Femur focal condensation, mode m=1)
Middle Zeugopod (Radius + Ulna / Tibia + Fibula Y-bifurcation, mode m=2)
Distal Urodele Forelimb Autopod (Metacarpals & Digits I-IV, mode m=4)
Distal Urodele Hindlimb / Pentadactyl Autopod (Metatarsals & Digits I-V, mode m=5)

aer_free_boundary_outgrowth_pass3.source: Oster, Murray & Maini (1985) Sec. 4 (AER-maintained recruitment/progress zone); Oster, Murray & Harris (1983) Sec. 5 (ECM anisotropy); Saunders (1948); ten Berge et al. (2008)
aer_free_boundary_outgrowth_pass3.description: 2D coupled cell-ECM PDE on a limb paddle with a moving free-boundary AER front L(t) = L_0 + v_AER t (lengths in units of lambda_c). Traction is suppressed and proliferation maintained in a progress zone of depth d_pz behind the front; chondrogenic competence chi = paddle(x,y) * front(y,t). Only the proximal humeral nucleus (y < L_0) is seeded.

saunders_1948_ablation_series.description: AER removed at t_ablate stops outgrowth and dissolves the progress zone; later removal leaves more distal segments (Saunders 1948 Figs. 2-9, chick wing stages 18-28 -> progressively more distal truncation levels).

hybrid_bsw_coupling_pass3.source: Raspopovic et al. (2014) Science 345:566-570 Fig. 2E / Supp. Sec. 1.2 linearised Bmp-Sox9-Wnt kinetics as vendored in datasets/bmp_sox9_wnt_digits/bmp_sox9_wnt_digits_reference.json (Slot 016); Hall & Miyake (2000) for condensation -> Sox9 induction
hybrid_bsw_coupling_pass3.wavelength_matching: d_scale = (q_c,BSW / k_c,mech)^2 scales D_B, D_W so the BSW Turing wavelength equals lambda_c

synergy_prediction.expected_phase: corr(n,S) > 0, corr(S,B) < 0, corr(S,W) < 0 (Raspopovic 2014 Fig. 1-2 out-of-phase Sox9 vs Bmp/Wnt)
